title: Ex 3.8 #15 · Rearranging TENNESSEE
prompt: How many different permutations (rearrangements) are there of the letters in the word TENNESSEE?
answer_format: A whole number, or an expression for it like 26^4 or binom(10, 3).

mistakes.hint: Swapping two identical letters, such as two of the E's, gives the same arrangement, so 9! counts each arrangement many times.
Check every repeated letter: E, N and S each appear more than once.

hints: Count how many times each letter appears: T, E, N, S.
Divide 9! by the factorial of each letter's count.
solution: TENNESSEE has 9 letters: one T, four E's, two N's and two S's.
By the formula for permutations of a multiset there are $\frac{9!}{1!\,4!\,2!\,2!} = \frac{362{,}880}{96} = 3780$ permutations.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words. Uses permutations of a multiset (Section 3.8).
